name: maadb
description: Use a MAADB project from Claude Code. Starts a local MAADB engine over stdio against a project folder you choose.

project_dir.title: MAADB project folder
project_dir.description: Absolute path to the MAADB project folder (the folder that holds _registry/ and _schema/). The engine reads and writes only inside it.

role.title: Role
role.description: reader can only read. writer can also create, update and delete records. admin can also reindex, back up and run cleanup tools.
